# codecut.ai

> > Codecut.ai aggregates content from Microsoft's productivity and AI ecosystem alongside TV Guide's entertainment scheduling platform.

This site appears to combine Microsoft's cloud, AI, and productivity tools (Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Copilot) with TV Guide's streaming and broadcast scheduling services. The dual focus spans enterprise productivity software and consumer entertainment discovery.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365 Copilot
- Copilot AI
- Windows 11
- TV Guide
- Microsoft 365
- Surface devices
- Xbox gaming
- Office apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- TV listings and schedules
- Entertainment news
- Productivity suite
- AI assistant
- Collaboration tools
- Streaming services
- Live sports broadcasts

## Core Platforms

- [Microsoft – AI, Cloud, Productivity, Computing, Gaming & Apps](https://microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft homepage showcasing products: Windows 11, Copilot, Xbox, Surface
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate with Office and AI](https://office.com): Microsoft 365 Copilot hub for Word, Excel, PowerPoint collaboration
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings and schedule for shows, movies, and programs

## Entertainment & Sports

- [Live Sports On TV Today](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, UEFA Champions League broadcasts

## Support & Account Management

- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft support hub for 365, Windows 11, Copilot troubleshooting
- [Microsoft account | Sign In or Create Your Account Today](https://account.microsoft.com/account): Microsoft account sign-in and creation portal

## Optional

- [Cary, NC TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV schedule for Cary, NC antenna and cable providers
- [Navarre, FL TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/32566-navarre-fl): Local TV schedule for Navarre, FL antenna and cable providers
